package.name: j10_safety
package.description:
The independent guardian: the only component with authority to veto a command before it reaches the flight controller. Applies input watchdogs, velocity clamps, acceleration limits, an altitude envelope, a virtual geofence, ground-proximity braking and a battery failsafe, and publishes a SafetyStatus naming every limit that was active.
Per boundary rule 3 in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md this package depends only on j10_interfaces and geometry_msgs, and the filter logic itself is pure C++ that is unit-testable with no simulator, no MAVROS and no GPU.
